title: bromus affinis
intro: Bromus affinis, commonly known as lesser brome or slender brome, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus affinis include expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, which help to relieve congestion and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Bromus affinis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
